summary: Frontend-only testing of PhiCor.ai Phase 2 visualization features. Verified (1) Differential Diagnosis Neural Network view toggle, (2) Food Analysis Body Map tab, and (3) Drug page Body Map tab. All three visualizations render correctly and toggles work as expected.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 422 with validation error 'detail: Array(2)' after clicking 'Run Complete Analysis'. Diagnosis list still renders but PhiCor Synthesis section errors out (visible in console). Not blocking the visualization toggle itself.

ui_bugs.issue: Body Map tab in Drug info view is missing data-testid='body-map-toggle'. Spec/agent_note explicitly states this testid should exist on Drug page too. Tab still works when clicked by text, but automation reliance on testid fails.
ui_bugs.selector: Drug page Body Map tab button (around DrugsPage.js lines 2060-2075)

ui_bugs.issue: React duplicate key warning for 'torsemide' and 'methotrexate' in the drug list rendering (console errors repeated). Non-unique keys can lead to duplicated/omitted rows.
ui_bugs.selector: drug list rendering (.map with key=drug name)

action_items: Add data-testid='body-map-toggle' to Drug page Body Map tab button for consistency with Food page and spec.
Fix duplicate React keys for 'torsemide' and 'methotrexate' in DrugsPage drug list (use unique id or index-based key).
Investigate the 422 error on Synthesis API triggered from Differential Diagnosis Clinical Text analysis (unrelated to visualization but user-visible in console).
critical_code_review_comments: DifferentialPage.js is 2119 lines and DrugsPage.js also very large; consider splitting into smaller focused modules for maintainability.
Neural network view header text 'Diagnostic Reasoning Map' rendered correctly with 9 nodes / 8 connections, SVG count ~41.
Food Body Map header 'Salmon Impact Map' rendered correctly with body silhouette + organ circles.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the three visualization flows tested

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing food chip 'Salmon' and drug 'Metformin'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Visualization features (Neural Network on Differential, Body Map on Food and Drug pages) are fully functional. Toggling between List/Network on Differential works; Body Map tab shows/hides on Food and Drug pages. Two follow-ups: missing data-testid='body-map-toggle' on Drug page Body Map tab and duplicate React keys in drug list. Also a pre-existing Synthesis API 422 error on Differential clinical-text analysis (does not block diagnosis rendering or the network view).
